messages.raw: §fIn order to better understand the cold, sometimes you have to get warm.
messages.text: In order to better understand the cold, sometimes you have to get warm.
messages.zh: 想把寒冷弄明白,有时候也得先暖和一下。
咱俩这交情,够冷静,也够铁。
